definition_zh: 幼稚无经验的；年轻无阅历的；（鸟）羽翼未丰的
definition_en: inexperienced and immature; also (of a young bird) without feathers
core_image: 一只刚破壳、绒毛未干的雏鸟张着嘴等食：什么都还没长成
scene: 初出校门的实习生第一次主持会议，紧张得连幻灯片都翻错了页。The callow intern assumed the deal would close in a week.
sceneCN: 这里 callow 是「幼稚无经验的」（第 2 个义项：缺乏阅历、想事简单）；句意是这位稚嫩的实习生以为一周内就能谈成这笔交易。

pos.zh: 幼稚无经验的；不成熟的

collocations.zh: 没见过世面的年轻男子

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「稚嫩；不成熟」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「稚嫩地；不老练地」（罕用）
形近词，源自另一词根 cal-（硬皮），义为「老茧；冷酷」，仅拼写相近

senses.title: Without feathers, of a young bird
senses.definition: describing a newly hatched bird that has not yet grown feathers
senses.definitionCN: 形容刚孵出、还没长出羽毛的雏鸟
senses.example: The callow nestlings waited with open beaks.
senses.exampleCN: 羽翼未丰的雏鸟张着嘴等食。
senses.why: The Old English source calu meant bald, so the literal image is bare, unfinished skin.
senses.whyCN: 古英语词源 calu 意为「光秃的」，字面意象就是裸露未长成的皮肉。

senses.title: Inexperienced and immature
senses.titleCN: 幼稚无经验的；不成熟的
senses.definition: lacking the experience, judgment, or polish that comes with age and practice
senses.definitionCN: 缺少年龄和实践带来的经验、判断力与老练
senses.example: He was too callow to negotiate with the veterans.
senses.exampleCN: 他太稚嫩了，没法和这些老手谈判。
senses.why: Just as a featherless bird cannot fly, an untested person cannot handle adult demands.
senses.whyCN: 正如没有羽毛的鸟飞不起来，未经世事的人也应付不了成人的事务。

senses.title: Young in a slightly dismissive way
senses.definition: young in a way the speaker finds naive or not worth taking seriously
senses.definitionCN: 年纪轻得让说话者觉得天真可笑、不足为惧
senses.example: Some callow junior dared to question the professor.
senses.exampleCN: 某个乳臭未干的小字辈竟敢质疑教授。
senses.why: Naming immaturity is a way of ranking: the featherless image doubles as an insult about status.
senses.whyCN: 点出「未长成」本身就是在排座次：光秃秃的意象同时暗含地位低微的贬义。

senses.title: Naive in outlook or style
senses.definition: showing naïveté in judgment, writing, or art that has not yet matured
senses.definitionCN: 判断、文章或艺术创作显出未经打磨的天真与稚拙
senses.example: His first novel is callow but full of promise.
senses.exampleCN: 他的第一部长篇小说稚拙，却充满潜力。
senses.why: What is literally unfinished shows the rough surface of an unformed skill.
senses.whyCN: 「未长成」的字面义投射到未打磨的技艺上，露出粗糙的表面。

intro.en: Callow descends from Old English calu, bald, from a Proto-Germanic root for bare skin; it moved from featherless birds to untested people.
intro.cn: callow 源自古英语 calu（光秃的），出自日耳曼语族一个表「裸露」的词根，再从「无毛的雏鸟」转指「未经磨砺的人」。

items.en: The reconstructed root *gel- / *kal- is associated with cold and bareness, the state of skin stripped of covering.
items.cn: 重构词根 *gel- / *kal- 与「寒冷、裸露」相关，指失去覆盖物的皮肤状态。

items.en: Germanic *kalwaz meant bald or bare, surviving in German kahl with the same meaning.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 *kalwaz 意为光秃的、裸的，德语 kahl 至今保留同义。

items.en: Old English calu meant bald or featherless, applied to people, animals, and even bare land.
items.cn: 古英语 calu 意为秃的、无毛的，可用于人、动物乃至裸露的土地。

items.en: By the sixteenth century the word had shifted from bald feathers to callow youth, immaturity in people.
items.cn: 至十六世纪，词义已从「无毛」转向 callow youth，形容人的不成熟。

items.en: Today the bird sense is rare and mainly literary; the immaturity sense dominates, often in the fixed phrase callow youth.
items.cn: 如今雏鸟义已罕见，主要见于文学；「不成熟」义占主导，常见固定搭配 callow youth。

note.en: Callow looks close to callous in sound and spelling but has a completely different root and meaning.
note.cn: callow 的音与形都和 callous 很接近，但词根与词义完全不同。

entries.definition: Emotionally hardened; indifferent to suffering; from the Latin root for hard skin.
entries.definitionCN: 冷酷无情的，对痛苦麻木；源自拉丁语「硬皮」词根，与 callow 词源不同。

entries.definition: A patch of hardened skin; also the Latin-rooted noun family of callous.
entries.definitionCN: 硬皮、老茧；属 callous 同一拉丁词族，与 callow 无关。

entries.definition: Not deep in thought or feeling; rhymes with callow but unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 思想或情感浅薄的，与 callow 押韵但词源无关。

entries.definition: Left unplanted, as of farmland; a near rhyme often confused in reading.
entries.definitionCN: （农田）休耕的，与 callow 形近音近，阅读时易混。

entries.definition: Inexperienced, as in a green recruit who has not learned the ropes.
entries.definitionCN: 没经验的，如尚未上手的「新手」green recruit。

entries.definition: Lacking worldly experience and too ready to believe others.
entries.definitionCN: 缺乏世故、轻信他人的天真者。

entries.definition: Not fully developed emotionally or behaviorally.
entries.definitionCN: 情感或行为上尚未发育成熟的。

entries.definition: A noun for an inexperienced newcomer.
entries.definitionCN: 指生手的名词，义为「新手、生瓜蛋子」。

entries.definition: Made experienced and competent by long practice.
entries.definitionCN: 经长期历练而老练的，是 callow 的反义对照。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the bald-bird image and the fixed phrase callow youth.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「光秃雏鸟」意象与固定搭配 callow youth 的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Root link: Old English calu, bald, survives inside callow, literally a bald, featherless bird.
normal.cn: 词根线索：古英语 calu（光秃的）藏在 callow 里，字面就是一只光秃秃没长毛的鸟。

normal.en: Fixed phrase: callow youth is the classic collocation in classic novels and exams.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：callow youth（少不更事的年轻人）是经典小说和考试中的标配组合。

normal.en: Contrast pair: callow (no experience) versus seasoned (full of experience) are natural antonyms.
normal.cn: 对比记忆：callow（零经验）与 seasoned（老练）是一对天然反义词。

normal.en: Sound guard: callow ends in -ow like shallow and fallow; callous ends in -ous; feel the rhyme to keep them apart.
normal.cn: 音形防守：callow 以 -ow 结尾，与 shallow、fallow 同韵；callous 以 -ous 结尾，靠韵脚分开。

normal.en: The German cousin kahl, bald, shows the same root still alive in another language.
normal.cn: 德语同源词 kahl（光秃的）证明这个词根在另一门语言里仍然存活。

abstract.en: A baby bird on the nest edge, wings bare and useless, certain it can fly.
abstract.cn: 巢边的雏鸟，翅膀光秃无用，却自信满满地认定自己会飞。

abstract.en: A fresh diploma in one hand and no idea what a deadline feels like.
abstract.cn: 一只手举着崭新的毕业证，另一只手对截止日期的滋味一无所知。

abstract.en: A green shoot: upright and alive, but one frost away from learning the world.
abstract.cn: 一株嫩芽：直挺挺地活着，但一场霜冻就会让它认识世界。

examples.en: The callow recruit apologized for the mistake he did not yet know how to avoid.
examples.cn: 这个稚嫩的新兵为自己还不知道如何避免的错误道歉。

examples.en: Her callow essays from the first semester bear no resemblance to her mature later work.
examples.cn: 她第一学期稚拙的文章与后来成熟的作品判若两人。

examples.en: In the film the callow youth grows into a hardened commander.
examples.cn: 影片中乳臭未干的少年成长为意志坚硬的指挥官。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「凯漏」——新人凯旋却处处露怯、漏洞百出，一看就是个没经验的雏儿；谐音联想到「凯」旋路上「漏」了怯，便是幼稚无经验的 callow。

root: 源自古英语 calu（光秃的、无毛的），出自原始日耳曼语 *kalwaz（裸的），与德语 kahl 同源；一般认为可上溯至印欧词根 *gel-（冷、裸露）。本义「光秃无毛」，十六世纪起转指人的「稚嫩无经验」。注意与拉丁词源的 callous（冷酷的）没有任何亲缘关系。

sensesIntro.en: From the literal featherless hatchling the word extends to untested people, dismissive comments about youth, and unpolished work.
sensesIntro.cn: 从字面的无毛雏鸟出发，词义延伸到未经磨砺的人、对年轻人的轻蔑评语以及未经打磨的作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hatchling with bare skin and no feathers, not yet ready for the sky.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只皮肉裸露、羽毛未生的雏鸟，还飞不上天。

branches.en: THE NEST: the bird sense, bare-skinned and flightless.
branches.cn: 鸟巢：雏鸟义，光秃无毛、不能飞。

branches.en: THE PERSON: inexperience that age and practice have not yet cured.
branches.cn: 人：年龄和实践尚未治愈的无经验。

branches.en: THE JUDGMENT: a dismissive label pinned on the young.
branches.cn: 评判：贴在年轻人身上的轻蔑标签。

branches.en: THE WORK: early writing or art that has not found its polish.
branches.cn: 作品：尚未打磨出光泽的早期文字或艺术。

branches.en: THE ARC: the standard growth story from callow to seasoned.
branches.cn: 成长弧线：从稚嫩到老练的经典叙事。

intro.en: Callow is a single inherited Germanic word, not built from prefix and suffix, so its story is the root calu itself.
intro.cn: callow 是一个日耳曼语系世代相传的单词，并非由前后缀拼装，它的故事全在词根 calu 之中。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family here; the root is Germanic, so the Latin list stays empty and cousins come from the Germanic side.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁词族；词根属日耳曼语系，拉丁同源列表留空，同族词来自日耳曼一侧。

items.exampleCN: 光头的少年（古英语用例示意）
系重构形式，无文献实证。
一棵光秃秃的树（德语用例示意）

items.meaningCN: 本土继承词的形容词词尾
items.exampleCN: 比较同为本土词的 fallow、shallow。

items.example: The play captures the callowness of early adulthood.
items.exampleCN: 这部戏剧捕捉了刚成年时的稚嫩。

items.example: No callow youth can run this trading desk.
items.exampleCN: 少不更事的孩子可掌管不了这个交易台。

items.meaningCN: 秃的；不加修饰的（同义异根的日耳曼词）
items.example: a bald eagle is not callow, merely white-headed
items.exampleCN: bald eagle（白头海雕）只是白头，并非 callow。
